comment: The building route model's cost table (docs/design/levelgen/gdd/building-route-model.md F1, opening-states.md F1; ADR-0001 one cost table, ADR-0002 cost_hash). Read by Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/buildingGraph.ts (ROUTE_COSTS, field docs on RouteCostTable) and later by the C++ runtime. Every stored route carries cost_hash = FNV-1a (8 hex) of this file's canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace; buildingRoutes.ts routeCostHash): any edit here, the comment included, marks stored key routes stale and they are recomputed on load. Units: m/s, s, cm, m; all values *proposal*.
